speaker: hero
text: Bit, my fridge is full. And there's *nothing* to eat.

speaker: bit
text: Classic. Open the fridge. Take *one photo*.

speaker: bit
text: Send it to any AI chat app that takes *pictures*.

speaker: bit
text: Then the important part. Give it *limits*.

speaker: hero
text: Why limits? Just ask for a *recipe*.

speaker: bit
text: Without limits, it suggests lasagna. And a trip to the *store*.

speaker: bit
text: Time. Only these ingredients. Your *skill level*.

speaker: hero
text: Fried rice? I had *all* of that?

speaker: bit
text: Step three. Ask for *two more* options.

speaker: bit
text: The first idea is rarely the *best* one.

speaker: hero
text: Can it tell if the milk is *still good*?

speaker: bit
text: No. It can't smell. Dates and allergies are *your* job.

speaker: bit
text: And one more thing it found in the photo.

speaker: bit
text: Follow for one AI trick a day.
